title: models
description: What each model's weights are, optional: data/models.yaml. Keyed by the model a run records (params.model). The arms page filters on it (open / proprietary) and `evh arms --weights` lists by it; a model not listed is unknown.

weights.description: open: the weights can be downloaded; proprietary: only its vendor serves it.

licence.description: The licence of open weights, as its publisher states it.
